title: Henry 'Nick' Turner the bass player
summary: Turner joined as bass player, played little elsewhere, and died in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: And Nick Turner, who did he play with?
Well, Nick was around here. Nick never played too much with anyone.
Well, he went on up north then.
He went with me as a bass player.
Yeah, but then afterwards he went up north or something.
But he didn't play with anyone. No, he died like I told you in this little, that stick in this little town.
No, he didn't die there, he died in Chicago.
Oh, I see. Well, there's another bass player named Turner. Not in my band. I must have been more confused, you know. Because... Could be two guys with the same name.
Yeah, well, we call him Nick. What was Nick's name? Henry Turner.
